commits.message:
fix(log): a disposed log registers no exit listener and a flush under way ends its own descriptor (candybar-testing-ihvy.yfv)

Review of #583: dispose() with a flush mid-open left the descriptor that
flush then opened, and a line logged after dispose re-registered the exit
listener. dispose now marks the log, defers the close to a flush in flight,
and a late line is written by a flush that ends its own open.

refactor(daemon): DaemonInputs.paths names only what createDaemon reads, and the harness ends every log it opens (candybar-testing-ihvy.yfv)

Review of #583: DaemonPaths drops the unread cache member and DaemonInputs
narrows to socket, state and watchProbe; the harness handle reports the log
path the daemon was built with, a failed build ends the log it opened, and
daemon-value ends every log a case opened. The memory lines that gave the
env-at-write-time reason for one live daemon and for paths-not-inputs now say
what is true.

refactor(daemon): createDaemon takes every adapter and every path as an input (candybar-testing-ihvy.yfv)

DaemonInputs gains a DaemonPaths value and DaemonAdapters (log, launcher,
storage, doctor stores and edge, Claude input, lane edge, link signer, limits,
fetch, stat). production-adapters.ts is the one module that names the real
ones; server.ts is the daemon process's one reader of paths.ts, and the page in
site/ and the test harness build over the same adapters. The log's module state
becomes a DaemonLog built over a path. OWNED_IMPORTS enforces the ownership.
The keyspaces and the Foundations row are carved to candybar-testing-ihvy.42w;
pricing's disk cache stays a named reader until its port (89p).

test(render): renderLines returns the one event per render its client kept (#582)

* test(render): renderLines returns the one event per render its client kept (brandon-unfiled-3248.8c9u)

The retry loop in renderRequest and renderLines now decide with one predicate, so a retried attempt is not read as a render. Also records the heap-snapshot class-name trap in testing.md.

* test(render): the kept-render pick is a pure function with its own test; comments and memory name the concept (brandon-unfiled-3248.8c9u)

* test(render): the retry loop and the reader share one answered-render pick, matching the session id as the daemon logs it (brandon-unfiled-3248.8c9u)

docs(design): the isolated daemon, tmux events and browser surface designs

Goals, architecture, contracts and one document per area, with the surveys and probes behind them. The Frame is recorded as built, and the browser surface is un-parked.
fix(bar-pane): a frame overwrites its rows and lands whole, so the pane stops flickering
